shellCommands.command: cd /workspace && rm -f package-lock.json && npm install 2>&1 | tail -30
cd /workspace && node --experimental-strip-types _smoke.ts 2>&1 | tail -20 && echo "--- books.json ---" && cat data/books.json

cd /workspace && ID=$(node -e "console.log(require('./data/books.json').books[0].id)") && echo "book id: $ID" && echo "--- HOME shows book ---" && curl -s http://localhost:3111/ | grep -o "The Pragmatic Programmer" | head -1 && echo "--- DETAIL page ---" && curl -s -o /tmp/detail.html -w "status=%{http_code}\n" "http://localhost:3111/books/$ID" && grep -o "The Pragmatic Programmer\|Hunt & Thomas\|finished\|DRY is not about duplication" /tmp/detail.html | sort -u

cd /workspace && pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "next-server" 2>/dev/null; rm -f _smoke.ts && printf '{ "books": [] }\n' > data/books.json && rm -rf .next && echo "cleaned up" && ls -la && echo "--- data/books.json ---" && cat data/books.json
cd /workspace && printf '{ "books": [] }\n' > data/books.json && rm -f _smoke.ts && ls -la && echo "--- git status ---" && git status --short && echo "--- data ---" && cat data/books.json
cd /workspace && pkill -f next 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; rm -rf .next tsconfig.tsbuildinfo; ls -d .next tsconfig.tsbuildinfo 2>/dev/null; echo "remaining next procs:"; pgrep -af next || echo none
cd /workspace && find app lib data -type f | sort && echo "--- typecheck ---" && npm run typecheck 2>&1 | tail -5 && echo "exit=$?"
